div.head: CHn cor 13
div.ab: Lagam regis Eadwardi uobis reddo cum illis emendationibus quibus pater meus eam emendauit consilio baronum suorum.
Lagam regis Edwardi vobis reddo cum illis emendationibus quibus pater meus eam emendavit consilio baronum suorum.
I restore to you the law of King Edward with all the reforms which my father introduced with the consent of his barons.

Cf. Gl Eadwardi laga 2. a ff.; in it was ‘the lawful freedom of the nation symbolised’; Stubbs Sel. char. 99. The sentence is used by Stephen in his charter of liberties of 1135. At the beginning of the 14th cent. this promise passed into the coronation oath; see above p. 144 n. 5. A partial fulfilment of this undertaking is found in Hn com 1. 4
